notes: Not pre-registered (17 Nov 2026; revised 17 Nov 2026 for rev3): re-writes by observed cause, the unbroken-message-chain check, the TTL-tier rule, list/prompt/version markers, the base rate of non-expiry invalidations, keepalive (hindsight and a capped policy), main-loop session statistics, and the orchestrator input since the executor's first turn.
Positional model per transcript; re-reads counted within the writing transcript only, so reads by other transcripts of a shared prefix are missed (re-reads are a lower bound).
Gap = time since the transcript's previous request, which refreshed every live entry.

Cause order: model change, compaction marker, list/prompt/version change, then gap and the TTL tier of the covering entries; one-hour entries re-written within the hour are not expiry. Microcompact leaves no marker; the base rate covers unobserved non-expiry invalidations.
A resumed session's first full write counts as a new-suffix write, so re-writes are a lower bound.

Keepalive assumes the prefix is held at the one-hour rate, nets out the base rate and ignores the pings' own uncached and output tokens; the hindsight figure knows the user returned, the capped policy does not.
